name: box_delivery
title: Box delivery: physical suction pick -> carry arc -> place -> rolling U-turn
summary: Physical suction pick-and-place with clean table departures: after the 1 cm-gated pickup, the G1 uses the load-proven carrier to follow a forward arc around cart A. At cart B it coasts to double support, arrests the achieved stance with a true zero velocity command, physically lowers/releases the box, withdraws the cups, and only then enables clearance locomotion. The walking navigator moves south away from cart B, then stays in forward locomotion through a wide open-floor U-arc. Reverse and stationary-turn specialists are not production-routed because they did not preserve stable travel in the full physical course. The box is never supervisor-moved. The lambda=0.9 weight-bearing balance harness remains active; this is not free-standing locomotion.
_turn_note: No in-place turn is attempted beside either cart. A forward carrier arc clears cart A and a south-then-east walking path clears cart B. The navigator then follows four open-floor waypoints as one continuous forward U-arc.
props: real 1.0 kg Newton box (DEF CARRY_BOX; never supervisor-moved)
harness_rig is telemetry-only in PHYS_GRASP mode (side log _scratch/foot_redesign/boxrig.log)
